# We Are Teachers

> We Are Teachers is a community hub providing classroom-ready lesson plans, teaching resources, free printables, and educator inspiration across K-12 grades.

We Are Teachers serves teachers with curated, classroom-tested resources organized by grade level and subject area. The site features teacher-endorsed product picks, interactive games, seasonal activities, and a vibrant community of educators sharing ideas and giveaways.

## Grade Level Resources

- [Grades K-5 Resources](https://www.weareteachers.com/grades/k-5): Curated K-5 teaching resources including lesson plans, literacy, and science projects.
- [Elementary School Resources](https://www.weareteachers.com/grades/elementary-school): Elementary school resources with lesson plans, worksheets, and classroom activities.
- [Grades 6-12 Resources](https://www.weareteachers.com/grades/6-12): Secondary education resources for grades 6-12 covering ELA, math, and science.
- [High School Resources](https://www.weareteachers.com/grades/high-school): High school teaching resources covering STEM, ELA, and classroom management.

## Subject-Specific Lesson Plans & Activities

- [Science Education Resources](https://www.weareteachers.com/topics/science): Science lesson plans, STEM projects, and hands-on experiments for K-12 classrooms.
- [English Language Arts Resources](https://www.weareteachers.com/topics/english-language-arts): ELA resources including poetry lessons, templates, and elementary writing activities.
- [Art & Creativity Resources](https://www.weareteachers.com/topics/arts): Art and creativity resources with grade-specific lessons and classroom projects.
- [Holidays & Seasons Activities](https://www.weareteachers.com/topics/holidays-seasons): Seasonal and holiday classroom activities, crafts, and lesson plans for all grades.
- [30 Hands-On Circulatory System Activities](https://www.weareteachers.com/circulatory-system-activities): 30 hands-on circulatory system activities and experiments for elementary science.
- [70 Free Directed Drawing Activities](https://www.weareteachers.com/directed-drawing-activities): 70 free step-by-step directed drawing activities for elementary art instruction.
- [Free Printable "I Am" Poem Template Bundle](https://www.weareteachers.com/i-am-poem-template): Free "I Am" poem templates for student reflection and creative writing activities.
- [Women's History Month Activities](https://www.weareteachers.com/womens-history-month-activities): Women's History Month classroom activities and free printables celebrating women leaders.

## Teacher Community & Culture

- [School Culture & Colleagues](https://www.weareteachers.com/topics/school-culture-colleagues): School culture resources covering teacher wellness, collaboration, and community.
- [How Twinning With Dad Became a Tradition for This Teacher](https://www.weareteachers.com/teacher-twinning-with-teacher-dad): Teacher story about father-daughter fifth-grade teaching duo and classroom traditions.

## Teacher Picks & Recommendations

- [Teacher Picks Hub](https://www.weareteachers.com/hub/teacher-picks): Teacher-endorsed educational products and classroom resources tested in real classrooms.
- [Teach Cell Signaling With This Hands-On Kit](https://www.weareteachers.com/teacher-picks-cell-signaling-kit): Teacher review of Bio-Rad Cell Signaling Kit for AP Biology hands-on learning.

## Interactive Resources & Giveaways

- [Game Hub](https://www.weareteachers.com/hub/online-activities-for-students): Interactive game hub with brain training, puzzles, and educational games for students.
- [Giveaways Hub](https://www.weareteachers.com/giveaways): Central hub for teacher giveaways and contests featuring partner promotions.
- [ThriftBooks Get Your Pages In Giveaway](https://www.weareteachers.com/hub/thriftbooks-get-your-pages-in-giveaway): ThriftBooks reading challenge giveaway with daily prizes and classroom resources.
